messages:
Rae (PM): heads-up: want to run a small DP onboarding experiment next week to cut time-to-first-success. idea: 3 lightweight touchpoints + instant help on auth errors. keep it low-friction.
Diego (Eng): sounds good. define 'first-success' so we can instrument it consistently across hosted vs private.
Rae (PM): hosted primary: successful API call that returns a schema-valid response. private: deploy health + sample inference. measure separately.
Tara (CS): agree on schema validation. propose we treat any match on the example probe intent as success (even if tokens differ). avoids flaky string matches.
Nina (DevEx): I'll build a one-click quickstart (button launches sample request in Console) + a tiny checklist modal. also add an optional one-question survey after success.
Li (Data): for stats, we need cohort tags (dp=true), variant id, and event names: signup, quickstart_clicked, auth_failed, success_probe_passed, survey_submitted.
Diego (Eng): estimate: events + quickstart + modal ~ 3 dev-days; auth detection + adaptive nudge + test harness ~1 day.
Rae (PM): variants: A=control (baseline), B=personalized example snippets (lang choice), C=auth-adaptive (immediate nudge when auth_failed). we'll randomize across DP signups.
Tara (CS): +1 on personalized snippets. also include an "integration checklist" attachable to partner invites. reduces support churn.
Nina (DevEx): note: for private deployments we can't run hosted quickstart. we'll surface a local-run checklist instead and mark them out of primary analysis.
Li (Data): success metrics: primary = % with success_probe_passed within 7 days. secondary = survey score (1-5), time-to-success median, support ticket rate within 30 days. target = +25% primary, -30% support for auth issues.
Rae (PM): launch gates: one of: 1) primary metric improves with p<0.05, or 2) auth support tickets drop by 40% and median time-to-success decreases. plus no negative cost/latency regression.
Diego (Eng): we'll add a feature-flagged rollout. safe to toggle if something breaks.
Nina (DevEx): deployment plan: quickstart feature flag, dashboard in Console (funnel view), and a message in the DP intake email. ETA for dashboard: 4 working days.
Li (Data): I'll prepare an A/B analysis notebook and a Redshift schema for events. need event definitions by EOD.
Tara (CS): copy: I'll draft the invite language: short, honest, mention 10-min setup and optional SE office hour. emphasize feedback helps product priorities.
Rae (PM): timeline: prep this week, start pilot on Mon for 2 weeks, reconvene after data collection. Can we be ready by Monday?
Diego (Eng): tight but doable if we scope minimal: quickstart button + events + dashboard.
Nina (DevEx): I'll prioritize quickstart flow and survey. post preflight tomorrow.
DeployBot: rollout-plan created for experiment "dp_onboard_touchpoints_v1". CI: all checks green. :white_check_mark:
Rae (PM): action list: Diego send event schema + FF hooks; Nina quickstart + modal; Li analysis spec; Tara invite copy; reconvene Fri 09:30 for preflight. thanks! :rocket:
